_definition: Companies whose stock is no longer tradable because a takeover, squeeze-out or delisting has COMPLETED (verified from at least one source). They remain in the 1,000-company scoring pool (so no other company's score or rank changes) but are hidden from the main table and the movers list and shown in the 'Delisted' window instead. Offers that are merely announced or pending are NOT listed here - those stay visible, annotated in Corporate actions. Maintained by hand; see docs/handoff-brief.md.
